easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Lord Feng triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 2.
